patterns.modulate: TEXEL0 * TEXEL1: both multiply the surface colour (structure or mottling over a colour carrier)
patterns.lerp_prim: TEXEL0 blended toward TEXEL1 by the primitive LOD fraction: two alternate variants of one surface (base and alt)
patterns.lerp_lod: TEXEL0 blended toward TEXEL1 by the LOD fraction (mip emulation): treat as the single texture a
patterns.lerp_alpha: TEXEL0 blended toward TEXEL1 by an alpha (decal over a base)
